editorial:
If you love big, loud action movies with movie stars, The Gray Man is right up your alley. Ryan Gosling plays Sierra Six, a CIA hitman who stumbles onto some dark agency secrets and suddenly becomes the target of every killer on the planet. Chris Evans steals the show as Lloyd Hansen, a mustache-twirling psycho who puts a bounty on Six's head and chases him across the globe. The vibe is pure popcorn fun, with huge set pieces, globe-trotting locations, and a tone that never takes itself too seriously. It feels like a throwback to old-school action flicks where the hero just keeps running and shooting.

The action is the real star here, with wild fight scenes and a massive shootout in Prague that will keep you glued to the screen. Gosling is cool and calm, while Evans clearly has a blast playing the villain. On the downside, the story is pretty thin and some characters feel underused, like Ana de Armas. Still, if you want a fun, no-brains-needed action night, this delivers. Grab some snacks and enjoy the ride.

The movie ends with Six and Claire safe together, though Six is still a wanted man. A post-credits scene hints that the CIA is still hunting him, setting up a possible sequel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big, loud action movies with movie stars.
